itineraries.title: Tamil Nadu Through the Five Senses
itineraries.tag-line: Travel Beyond the Ordinary. Experience the Extraordinary.
itineraries.description: Discover Tamil Nadu through its timeless temples, magnificent heritage, living craft traditions, and vibrant harvest celebrations. From the sacred banks of the Kaveri and the artistic treasures of Thanjavur to the warmth of a village Pongal celebration, the cool mountain landscapes of Kodaikanal, the ancient stories of Keeladi, and the distinctive flavours of Chettinad and Madurai, this thoughtfully curated journey invites you to experience the soul of Tamil Nadu through all five senses. See its architectural wonders, taste its regional delicacies, touch its traditional crafts, hear its stories and musical traditions, and feel the warmth of its people and living culture.

itineraries.title: Jewels of Japan – Cherry Blossom Special 2027
itineraries.tag-line: Experience the Magic of Japan's Cherry Blossom Season
itineraries.description: Experience the magical beauty of Japan during cherry blossom season on a 7-night, 8-day journey through Tokyo, Mt. Fuji, Hakone, Hamamatsu, Kyoto, Osaka, Hiroshima, Nara, and Kansai. Discover Tokyo's cultural landmarks and immersive digital art at teamLab Planets, admire the majestic Mt. Fuji, enjoy a scenic Lake Ashi cruise and Owakudani Ropeway, explore Kyoto's historic temples and Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, travel aboard the famous Shinkansen Bullet Train to Hiroshima, and discover Nara's deer park and Osaka's vibrant shopping streets. Enjoy Japan's breathtaking Sakura landscapes, authentic sushi tasting, and unforgettable cultural experiences.

itineraries.title: France & Switzerland Tour Package
itineraries.tag-line: Discover Parisian Elegance & Swiss Alpine Beauty
itineraries.description: Experience the charm of France and the breathtaking beauty of Switzerland on a 9-night, 10-day journey through Paris, Zurich, Lucerne, Interlaken, and Grindelwald. Discover Paris's iconic Eiffel Tower, enjoy a scenic Seine River cruise, explore the Louvre Museum and the magnificent Palace of Versailles, and stroll through the charming Montmartre district. Continue to Switzerland to experience the Lindt Home of Chocolate, admire panoramic Alpine views from Harder Kulm, discover the turquoise waters of Lake Brienz, and explore the picturesque mountain village of Grindelwald. Enjoy an unforgettable European holiday combining culture, history, scenic landscapes, and relaxation.
